newsitem.title: USA: Albertson's stock plunges on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Albertson's stock plunges on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Albertson's Inc., the retail food-drug chain, plunged Monday after the Boise, Idaho-based company said its earnings for the next two quarters would be below Wall Street's expectations.
Albertson's was off $6.375, or more than 15 percent, to $36.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.

The company estimated its profits for the third quarter ending on Oct. 31 at 42 cents a share, below analysts' forecasts of about 48 cents a share and flat with last year's results. It also saw flat fourth quarter earnings of 61 cents a share.
Albertson's said it was facing increasingly stiff competition in some markets.

"Although sales continue to increase, the increases are not meeting the company's expectations," it said. "Costs are above the originally projected amounts as a result of investments in programmes to enhance long-term sales growth."
